reason: The contract shows pricing errors: Ambulatory Ophthalmic Case Conference is billed at 20,310 cents per visit (3 × 20,310 = 60,930 cents) despite the contract rate of 16,925 cents and no applicable premium; Standard Endocrine Endoscopic Procedure is billed at 62,225 cents per procedure (2 × 62,225 = 124,450 cents) but the contract rate is 124,450 cents per procedure; Advanced Metabolic Anaesthesia Administration should be excluded (within 7 days of Standard Endocrine Endoscopic Procedure) and thus billed at 0 cents, yet 92,000 cents were charged. These violations justify the pricing_mismatch finding.
